commit_message:
mqtt: free any leftover when done

Oss-fuzz found an issue when the "sendleftovers" pointer could leak memory.
Fix this by always freeing it (if still assigned) in the done function.

Bug: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=43515
Closes #8274

location.description: Second free of sendleftovers in the newly added done callback.

findings.message: The retry frees a captured sendleftovers pointer after mqtt_send returns an allocation error, but the MQTT owner still retains it. The newly added mqtt_done callback frees that same pointer again.

related_locations.description: Retry captures and frees the old remainder without clearing its owner.

findings.title: Double free of MQTT send remainder after retry allocation failure

ground_truth.root_cause: mqtt_doing captures mq->sendleftovers and frees the captured pointer after mqtt_send, while mq->sendleftovers can still own that same allocation if the retry exits on an allocation error. The newly added mqtt_done then frees it again. A supported repair may keep the 2022 char-pointer representation: detach the old remainder from the MQTT owner and clear its count before retrying; free only the captured old allocation afterward; have mqtt_done free any remainder still owned at completion. Preserve successful MQTT send behavior and avoid APIs that do not link in a normal 2022 build.
